name: EAGLE-1 acceptance length and speedup on Vicuna-13B (temperature=0)
methodology: temperature=0, 6 tasks. Average acceptance length τ = 3.82 tokens per draft-verify cycle. Speedup 2.95x mean across tasks.
notes: EAGLE-1 uses static draft tree with feature-level autoregression. Baseline is vanilla autoregressive decoding. EAGLE-2 improves over EAGLE-1 by 20-40% via context-aware dynamic draft trees.
